There's a beach with a nice bar,
and an amusement park with cool rollercoaster rides and fun games,
and a resort with a mall,
a large ballroom for dance parties,
and so much more to offer! Do you have any questions?

Are you really sure you can eat chocolate! It's toxic for cats!
They should add that to shark tank!
I found a star, a cat, and a 67 seashell!
How's it like being the new CEO of scratch?
It's pretty nice Gobo! By the way, the sandcastle competition is gonna start!
